column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only correction memory of the ChangeMap lower-bound replay (self-improving recipe invariant): every correction of the re-seal, replay or oracle is one row, appended in the same commit as the fix.

column4: the donor manifest pins m3/file/src/main/java/com/m3/file/M3FileEditBatch.java (blob 87dd9d82, sha256 7612ebe0); the live owner is m3/file/src/main/java/jdk/m3/file/M3FileEditBatch.java (blob 5ef6e08f78, sha256 97a80e67) after the JDK naming rename, so the canonical recipe would refuse with "required source missing"
column5: the templates are derived mechanically: the package declaration follows NAMING_RULES.tsv PKG_COM_M3 and the postimage gains the three //FLLDCIM: anchors; reseal.py refuses unless the derived preimage equals the live receiver byte for byte
column8: a donor recipe pinned to a renamed path is re-sealed from the rename rules, never re-pinned by hand

column4: the only local com.synexia:synexia-openrewrite-recipes jar (1.0.0-SNAPSHOT, 2026-09-28) predates M3HashPinnedJavaSnapshotRecipe, so the donor runtime could not execute the crate
column5: apply.py performs the recipe's exact text contract (preimage sha256 -> reviewed template, postimage sha256 = fixed point, hunk-only guard) and the in-repo jdk.internal.m3.rewrite.M3HashPinnedJavaSnapshotRecipe replays the same crate under JUnit
column8: the replay and the canonical recipe must agree on the postimage hash; whichever one runs, the other proves it

column4: the first run compiled every class of jdk.m3.file and failed on master's unrelated duplicate M3BuildImpactPlan.requireSnapshot (2f708ccfd817 + ce7051f77ca0); the second run used -sourcepath over a flat directory and javac could not resolve M3FileSource
column5: lane sources are laid out by package directory, only the owner and the proof are named, -sourcepath pulls the closure (M3FileSource, M3File, M3StreamProgress) implicitly; javac output is printed on failure
column7: differential.py lanes compile with -Xlint:all -Werror and print one PASS line each; DIFFERENTIAL.tsv status EQUAL
